evidence.explanation: C Is_earthlevel expands through Lcheck/Lassigned to on_level; the explicit JS on_level call is not an extra boundary effect. The proof is limited to assigned Earth/current level records and the tested nonempty map fixtures.
evidence.proof: Twenty-four non-Earth targets and12 Earth controls: six nonempty floor/walled-room layouts × maze flag0/1, with different dungeon/same floor and same dungeon/different floor targets. Exact compiled C bound_digging/get_level_extends/on_level and upstream Earth macros match the real exported JS routines on all1680 wall_info bytes and four boundary coordinates. Earth controls leave all masks0; non-Earth cases set nondiggable8/nonpasswall16 at the expected boundaries.
evidence.control: Earth coordinates equal current coordinates, so the boundary operation leaves the entire map unrestricted. Non-Earth targets separately distinguish dnum and dlevel equality. Terrain remains unchanged in all cases. Typed GameMap/C-grid fixtures are explicit lower-level construction states, not full public loader, shipped recording or runtime proofs. Empty/all-STONE maps, unassigned/invalid level records, preexisting property flags, other layouts and runtime digging/phasing remain outside scope.
